title: Digital Marketing Manager - Luxury
description:
The Digital Marketing Manager - Luxury will oversee the creation and execution of marketing campaigns, ensuring they align with the organisation's goals and enhance its online presence. Based in Surrey, this role supports the business services industry by driving digital strategies that deliver measurable results. Ideally, you will have experience in and/or a passion for the design, interiors and luxury sector.

Client Details

A consumer organisation located in Surrey, providing hybrid working.

Description

The successful Digital Marketing Manager - Luxury will
- Develop and implement digital marketing strategies to support business objectives.
- Manage and optimise campaigns across multiple channels, including social media, email, and paid advertising.
- Analyse campaign performance and provide actionable insights to improve results.
- Oversee the creation of engaging content tailored to target audiences.
- Maintain and update the company website to ensure it aligns with brand standards.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure consistency across all marketing efforts.
- Monitor industry trends and competitor activities to identify growth opportunities.
- Ensure all marketing activities comply with relevant regulations and best practices.

Profile

A successful Digital Marketing Manager - Luxury should have
- Strong experience in planning and managing digital marketing campaigns.
- Ideally, proficiency in tools such as Google Analytics, SEO platforms, and social media management tools.
- Excellent analytical skills to assess campaign performance and ROI.
- Solid understanding of website management and content creation.
- Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
- Experience in, or a passion for, the luxury, interior or premium sectors.

title: Ecommerce Execution Assistant
description:
Ecommerce Execution Assistant

Location: Woking - Hybrid (3 days office / 2 days WFH)

An exciting opportunity for an Ecommerce Execution Assistant - EMEA to join a well-known, leading consumer goods company based in Woking.

Reporting to the Head of Ecommerce, EMEA, this is a hands-on role supporting ecommerce performance across globally recognised brands, with a particular focus on Amazon EMEA.

You'll help ensure product content is accurate and engaging, support new product launches, improve search visibility and analyse online performance to identify opportunities for growth.

The Role
- Support new product launches across EMEA, ensuring listings and digital assets are ready for launch.
- Manage and optimise product listings across Amazon and other ecommerce retailers.
- Support SEO and keyword optimisation to improve product visibility and search rankings.
- Assist with digital content including product imagery, A+ Content and Storefront assets.
- Monitor ecommerce performance, including traffic, conversion and digital shelf metrics.
- Identify and resolve catalogue and listing issues.
- Monitor competitor activity, customer reviews and online promotions.
- Work closely with internal teams, agencies and ecommerce partners across EMEA.

About You

We're looking for someone who is proactive, analytical, organised and commercially minded, with:
- Experience or exposure to ecommerce, digital marketing, content management or data analytics.
- Strong attention to detail and an eye for digital presentation.
- Confidence working with data, spreadsheets and reports.
- An understanding of SEO and ecommerce customer journeys.
- Strong problem-solving and organisational skills.
- An interest in ecommerce, digital trends and AI tools.

Experience with Amazon Vendor/Seller Central, Canva, Photoshop or ecommerce keyword tools would be beneficial but is not essential.

This is a fantastic opportunity to develop your ecommerce career within a leading international consumer goods business.

Apply now to find out more.

title: Marketing Account Manager
description:
We have an amazing opportunity for an experienced Marketing Success Manager to join one of the UK's fastest-growing B2 B marketing agencies. Working with ambitious technology businesses, you will build long-term client relationships, develop innovative marketing strategies, and deliver campaigns that drive real commercial results.

If you are looking to take the next step in your agency career and work with a business that values creativity, innovation and professional development, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Location: Hybrid Woking, Surrey (2 days in the office)

Candidates must have the following skills, experience and qualifications to be considered:
- Minimum 2-3 years' Account Management experience within a marketing agency
- At least 2 years' B2 B marketing experience
- Strong understanding of digital marketing channels including SEO, paid media, social media and marketing automation
- Experience creating and delivering successful marketing campaigns
- Excellent client relationship and communication skills
- Strong project management and organisational skills
- Experience with HubSpot, Pardot or similar marketing automation platforms would be advantageous
- Knowledge of the B2 B technology sector is desirable

You will receive:
- Competitive salary of £40,000 - £50,000 DOE
- Hybrid working (2 days per week in the Woking office)
- Flexible working around core hours
- Career progression within a rapidly growing agency
- Opportunity to work with innovative B2 B technology clients
- Ongoing learning and professional development
- Collaborative and supportive team environment

Due to the high volume of applications Recruited UK receives, we will make every effort to respond with feedback, although this is not always possible.

If you have not been contacted within 5 days, then unfortunately you have not been successful on this occasion, but we may keep your details on file and contact you with future opportunities.

If you feel you match the criteria above, please apply.

title: Organic Social and Content Specialist
description:
Organic Social & Content Specialist

Location: Woking, Surrey Hybrid (2 days per week in the office)
Salary: £32,000 £37,000 per annum
Job Type: Permanent

The Opportunity

We are working with an established and growing B2 B marketing agency that is looking for an experienced Organic Social & Content Specialist to join its Content & Creative team.

This is an exciting opportunity for a creative and commercially minded content professional who enjoys turning complex B2 B propositions into clear, engaging and effective content.

The Role

As the Organic Social & Content Specialist, you will:
- Plan and manage organic social media activity across multiple B2 B client accounts.
- Develop content plans and write engaging, platform-specific social copy, particularly for LinkedIn.
- Manage scheduling, approvals, publishing, quality assurance and community management.
- Work closely with designers and the Creative team to develop distinctive social content and assets.
- Monitor social performance and use insights to recommend improvements.
- Produce high-quality website copy, landing pages, SEO content, thought leadership and other written materials.
- Research complex B2 B subjects and interview client subject-matter experts to create credible and accessible content.
- Use AI tools thoughtfully to support research, ideation, content repurposing and production while maintaining originality and editorial quality.

About You

We are looking for someone with at least two years' experience working in an organic social and content role within a B2 B marketing agency.

You will ideally have:
- Proven experience managing organic social media for multiple clients.
- Strong LinkedIn knowledge and experience creating content specifically for B2 B audiences.
- A portfolio demonstrating excellent social and written content.

Apply Now

If you're ready for your next challenge and believe your experience matches this opportunity, please apply with your CV
